questions.en: In computer networks, the primary protocol responsible for routing packets across heterogeneous networks at Layer 3 is
questions.hi: कम्प्यूटर नेटवर्क में लेयर 3 पर विभिन्न नेटवर्कों में पैकेट रूटिंग के लिए मुख्य प्रोटोकॉल कौन-सा है?
options: TCP
IP (Internet Protocol)
HTTP
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: The Internet Protocol (IP) operates at Layer 3 (Network Layer) of the OSI model, handling logical addressing and host-to-host packet routing across internetworks. TCP operates at Layer 4 (Transport).💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Layer 3 (Network) = IP, Routers, Packets; Layer 4 (Transport) = TCP/UDP, Port numbers, Segments.

questions.en: When a key is pressed on keyboard, which standard is used for converting the keystroke into the corresponding bits?
questions.hi: जब कीबोर्ड पर एक कुंजी दबाई जाती है, तो कीस्ट्रोक को संबंधित बिट्स में परिवर्तित करने के लिए किस मानक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
options: ANSI
ASCII
EBCDIC
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: The American Standard Code for Information Interchange (ASCII) is the universal character encoding standard that maps alphanumeric keystrokes into 7-bit or 8-bit binary codes recognized by computer controllers.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Standard PC keystroke mapping = ASCII (7-bit standard, 8-bit extended); IBM mainframes traditionally used EBCDIC.

questions.en: What difference do the fifth generation computers have from other generation computers?
questions.hi: पाँचवीं पीढ़ी के कंप्यूटरों में अन्य पीढ़ी के कंप्यूटरों से क्या मुख्य अंतर है?
options: Technological advancement (Artificial Intelligence & Ultra Large Scale Integration)
Object-oriented programming
Scientific code
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.answer_text: Technological advancement (Artificial Intelligence & Ultra Large Scale Integration)Detailed
questions.explanation: Fifth-generation computing devices are characterized by parallel processing hardware and Artificial Intelligence (AI) algorithms utilizing ULSI (Ultra Large Scale Integration), differentiating them from earlier silicon microprocessor generations.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Computer Generations: 1st = Vacuum tubes; 2nd = Transistors; 3rd = Integrated Circuits (IC); 4th = VLSI Microprocessors; 5th = ULSI & Artificial Intelligence.

questions.en: Source code is available to view, modify and redistribute in
questions.hi: स्रोत कोड देखने, संशोधित करने और पुनर्वितरित करने के लिए किसमें उपलब्ध रहता है?
options: open source software
licensed software
proprietary software
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Open-source software licenses (e.g., GNU GPL, Apache, MIT) grant users the legal rights to inspect, alter, enhance, and freely redistribute the underlying human-readable source code.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Free to modify & distribute = Open Source; Closed binary without source code = Proprietary/Commercial (e.g., MS Windows).

questions.en: Machine language is(
questions.hi: मशीनी भाषा (Machine Language) होती है)
options: machine dependent
difficult to program
error prone
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.answer_text: More than one of the aboveDetailed
questions.explanation: Machine language consists of raw binary 0s and 1s directly executed by the CPU. It is strictly architecture-dependent, exceptionally tedious and difficult for humans to write, and highly prone to programmer errors.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: All three statements (A), (B), and (C) are classic limitations of raw binary machine code, making Option (D) the official answer.

questions.en: An assembly language is a/an(
questions.hi: एक असेम्ब्ली भाषा (Assembly Language) है)
options: low-level programming language
middle-level programming language
internet-based programming language
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Assembly language is a low-level programming language that provides mnemonic representations of machine instructions with a nearly 1:1 correspondence to processor opcodes, requiring an assembler to produce machine code.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Low-level languages = Machine Language (Binary) & Assembly Language (Mnemonics like MOV, ADD); High-level = C++, Java, Python.

questions.en: A compiler is a translating program which
questions.hi: कंपाइलर एक अनुवाद करने वाला प्रोग्राम है, जो
options: translates instructions of a high-level language into machine language
translates entire source program into machine language program at once
is not involved in program's execution directly
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.answer_text: More than one of the aboveDetailed
questions.explanation: A compiler converts high-level programming language source code into executable machine code by translating the entire source program at once before execution time, fulfilling both (A) and (B).💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Because both (A) (translates high-level to machine) and (B) (translates entire program at once) describe compiler functionality, Option (D) is triggered.

questions.en: Which of the following programming approaches is fundamentally adopted by C++?
questions.hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा दृष्टिकोण C++ द्वारा मुख्य रूप से उपयोग किया जाता है?
options: Left-right approach
Top-down approach
Bottom-up approach
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Object-Oriented Programming languages like C++ follow a Bottom-up design paradigm where low-level objects and classes are created first and aggregated together to form larger subsystems. Procedural C uses Top-down.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Paradigm rule: Object-Oriented (C++, Java) = Bottom-Up; Procedural / Structured (C, Pascal) = Top-Down.

questions.en: What is virtual inheritance in C++?(C++
questions.hi: में वर्चुअल इन्हेरिटन्स (Virtual Inheritance) क्या होता है?)
options: C++ technique to enhance multiple inheritance
C++ technique to ensure that a private member of the base class can be accessed somehow
C++ technique to avoid multiple copies of the base class into children/derived class
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.answer_text: C++ technique to avoid multiple copies of the base class into children/derived classDetailed
questions.explanation: Virtual inheritance resolves the ambiguity of the 'Diamond Problem' in multipath inheritance by ensuring that only one shared sub-object instance of an indirect base class is included in the most derived class.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Virtual base class = Solves Diamond problem by ensuring exactly one shared copy of the base class.

questions.en: What happens if the following C++ statement is compiled and executed?`int* ptr = NULL;``delete ptr;`
questions.hi: यदि निम्नलिखित C++ कथन संकलित और निष्पादित किया जाए, तो क्या होगा?
options: The program is not semantically correct
The program is compiled and executed successfully
The program is compiled successfully but throws an error during runtime
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.answer_text: The program is compiled and executed successfullyDetailed
questions.explanation: In standard C++, applying the `delete` operator to a null pointer (`NULL` or `nullptr`) is explicitly guaranteed by the language standard to be a safe no-operation that compiles and executes without runtime error.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Deleting a NULL pointer in C++ is completely safe and valid; the compiler simply does nothing.

questions.en: What is the difference between 'delete' and 'delete[]' in C++?
questions.hi: C++ में delete और delete[] के बीच क्या अंतर है?
options: Delete is syntactically correct but delete is wrong and will give error
Delete is used to delete normal objects whereas delete is used to delete pointer objects
Delete is used to delete a single object whereas delete is used to delete multiple (array of) objects
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.answer_text: Delete is used to delete a single object whereas delete[] is used to delete multiple (array of) objectsDetailed
questions.explanation: Memory dynamically allocated with `new` must be freed with `delete`, which invokes a single destructor. Dynamically allocated arrays created with `new[]` must be deallocated with `delete[]` to invoke destructors for each element.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Match the operators: `new` -> `delete` (single object); `new[]` -> `delete[]` (array of objects).

questions.en: What happens if the following program is executed in C and C++?`#include<stdio.h>``int main(void) { int new = 5; printf("%d", new); }`
questions.hi: यदि निम्नलिखित प्रोग्राम C और C++ में निष्पादित किया जाए, तो क्या होता है?
options: Error in C and successful execution in C++
Error in both C and C++
Error in C++ and successful execution in C
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.answer_text: Error in C++ and successful execution in CDetailed
questions.explanation: In C, `new` is not a reserved keyword and can be used as a valid variable identifier. In C++, `new` is a built-in memory allocation operator keyword, causing a syntax compilation error.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: `new`, `delete`, `class`, `template`, `virtual` are keywords in C++, but ordinary legal identifiers in C.

questions.en: What is the value of 'p' in the following C++ code snippet?`int p; bool a = true; bool b = false; int x = 10; int y = 5;``p = ((x | y) + (a + b));`
questions.hi: निम्नलिखित C++ कोड स्निपेट में 'p' का मान क्या है?
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Bitwise OR: `x | y = 10 | 5 = 1010_2 | 0101_2 = 1111_2 = 15`. Boolean addition promoting to integers: `a + b = 1 + 0 = 1`. Thus `p = 15 + 1 = 16`.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Binary bitwise math: 10 = 1010; 5 = 0101; 10 | 5 = 1111 = 15. In arithmetic expressions, `true` evaluates to 1 and `false` to 0.

questions.en: The C++ code which causes abnormal termination/behaviour of a program should be placed inside which block?
questions.hi: C++ कोड, जो किसी प्रोग्राम के असामान्य समापन/व्यवहार का कारण बन सकता है, उसे किस ब्लॉक के अंतर्गत लिखा जाना चाहिए?
options: catch block
throw block
try block
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Statements that may potentially raise runtime exceptions are enclosed within a `try` block. If an exception occurs, it is thrown (`throw`) and transferred to the matching `catch` handler block.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Code that might fail goes in `try`; code that handles the error goes in `catch`; keyword to initiate error is `throw`.

questions.en: What will be the output of the following C++ code?`void square(int* x, int* y) { *x = (*x) * --(*y); }``int main() { int number = 30; square(&number, &number); cout << number; }`
questions.hi: What will be the output of the following C++ code?`void square(int* x, int* y) { *x = (*x) * --(*y); }``int main() { int number = 30; square(&number, &number); cout << number; }`
options: Segmentation fault
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Both pointers `x` and `y` reference the same memory location `number` (30). Pre-decrement `--(*y)` decreases `number` from 30 to 29. Multiplication evaluates as `30 * 29 = 870` stored back into `*x`.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Aliasing pointer evaluation: `30 * 29 = 870`. Common BPSC programming puzzle.

questions.en: Pick the INCORRECT statement about inline functions in C++.(C++
questions.hi: में इन्लाइन फ़ंक्शंस (Inline Functions) के बारे में ग़लत कथन चुनें।)
options: They save overhead of a return call from a function
They are generally very large and complicated functions
These functions are inserted/substituted at the point of call
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.answer_text: They are generally very large and complicated functionsDetailed
questions.explanation: Inline functions should be small, simple utility routines (typically 1–3 lines). If large or complex functions with loops or recursion are inlined, it causes severe code bloat and the compiler ignores the inline request.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Statement (B) is false: inline functions should never be large or complicated; statements (A) and (C) are accurate definitions.

questions.en: What is an abstract class in C++?(C++
questions.hi: में ऐब्सट्रैक्ट क्लास (Abstract Class) क्या है?)
options: Any class in C++ from which another class is derived
Class specifically used as a base class with at least one virtual function
Class specifically used as a base class with at least one pure virtual function
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.answer_text: Class specifically used as a base class with at least one pure virtual functionDetailed
questions.explanation: In C++, an abstract class is defined as any class containing at least one pure virtual function (syntax: `virtual void func() = 0;`). Abstract classes cannot be instantiated directly and serve as interfaces.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Normal virtual function = Polymorphism; **Pure virtual function (`= 0`) = Abstract Class** (cannot instantiate objects).

questions.en: Which of the following constructors is automatically provided by the C++ compiler if not explicitly defined in a class?
questions.hi: यदि किसी क्लास में परिभाषित नहीं किया गया है, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कंस्ट्रक्टर C++ कंपाइलर द्वारा स्वचालित रूप से प्रदान किया जाता है?
options: Copy constructor
Default constructor
Parameterized constructor
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.answer_text: More than one of the aboveDetailed
questions.explanation: If no user-defined constructors exist, the C++ compiler automatically synthesizes both an implicit parameterless Default Constructor and an implicit Default Copy Constructor (performing memberwise copy).💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: The compiler provides both the Default Constructor AND the Copy Constructor automatically, triggering Option (D).

questions.en: How do structures (`struct`) and classes (`class`) in C++ differ?
questions.hi: C++ में structures और classes किस प्रकार भिन्न हैं?
options: In structures, members are private by default whereas in classes, they are public by default
In structures, members are public by default whereas in classes, they are private by default
Structures cannot have private members whereas classes can have
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.answer_text: In structures, members are public by default whereas in classes, they are private by defaultDetailed
questions.explanation: The only syntactic distinction between `struct` and `class` in C++ is default access: `struct` members and base inheritance are `public` by default, whereas `class` members and inheritance are `private` by default.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: BPSC core rule: `struct` = public by default (for C compatibility); `class` = private by default (for data hiding).

questions.en: Which of the following features must be supported by any programming language to become a pure object-oriented programming language?
questions.hi: शुद्ध ऑब्जेक्ट-ओरिएंटेड प्रोग्रामिंग भाषा बनने के लिए किसी भी प्रोग्रामिंग भाषा द्वारा निम्नलिखित में से किस विशेषता का समर्थन किया जाना चाहिए?
options: Encapsulation
Inheritance
Polymorphism
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.answer_text: More than one of the aboveDetailed
questions.explanation: A pure object-oriented programming language (like Smalltalk) must strictly satisfy all foundational OOP pillars: Encapsulation, Inheritance, Polymorphism, and Abstraction, with all primitive types modeled as objects.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Pillars of OOP: Encapsulation, Inheritance, Polymorphism, Abstraction. All are mandatory, hence Option (D).

questions.en: The programming language that has the inherent ability to define new data types is called(
questions.hi: वह प्रोग्रामिंग भाषा, जिसमें नए डेटा प्रकार (Data Types) बनाने की क्षमता होती है, कहलाती है)
options: overloaded language
encapsulated language
extensible language
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: An extensible language allows programmers to define new data types (via classes and structures) along with user-defined operators that behave identically to built-in primitive language types.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Ability to define custom types and operators = Extensible language.

questions.en: Who is the original creator and designer of the C++ programming language?
questions.hi: इनमें से कौन C++ प्रोग्रामिंग भाषा का मूल निर्माता है?
options: Dennis Ritchie and Brian Kernighan
Ken Thompson
Bjarne Stroustrup
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Bjarne Stroustrup created C++ at Bell Laboratories in 1979 as an extension of the C language, originally naming it 'C with Classes'. Dennis Ritchie created C.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: C Language = Dennis Ritchie; C++ = Bjarne Stroustrup; Java = James Gosling; Python = Guido van Rossum.

questions.en: Which of the following represents the correct syntax to read a single character from the console stream in C++?(C++
questions.hi: भाषा में कंसोल से एकल वर्ण (single character) को पढ़ने के लिए सही वाक्य विन्यास कौन-सा है?)
options: read_ch()
getline_ch()
cin.get(ch)
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: The member function `cin.get(char& ch)` reads the next single character (including whitespace and newlines) directly from the standard input stream into the specified character variable.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Single character input = `cin.get(ch)`; formatted extraction = `cin >> ch` (skips whitespace); string line = `getline(cin, str)`.

questions.en: In C++, which expression correctly accesses the n-th element of an array named 'array'?
questions.hi: C++ में, कौन-सा व्यंजक 'array' नामक ऐरे के n-वें तत्त्व को सही ढंग से दर्शाता है?
options: array;
array;
array;
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Because C and C++ utilize zero-based array indexing, the first element is at index 0, the second at index 1, and the n-th element is situated at index position `n - 1`.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Zero-based indexing rule: First element = `arr[0]`; n-th element = `arr[n-1]`; `arr[n]` is out of bounds for an array of size n.

questions.en: How many fundamental structural categories of arrays are there in the C++ programming language?
questions.hi: C++ प्रोग्रामिंग भाषा में ऐरे के मुख्य रूप से कितने संरचनात्मक प्रकार होते हैं?
options: There are three types of arrays
There are four types of arrays
There are two types of arrays (Single-dimensional and Multidimensional)
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.answer_text: There are two types of arrays (Single-dimensional and Multidimensional)Detailed
questions.explanation: In standard computer science classification, arrays in C++ are categorized into two primary types: Single-dimensional (linear) arrays and Multidimensional arrays (2D matrices, 3D grids).💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Array categories: 1D (Single-dimensional) and Multi-D (2D, 3D, etc.) = 2 types.

questions.en: In modern C++ Standard Template Library / type traits, for what purpose is 'rank' used?
questions.hi: C++ में, 'rank' का उपयोग किस उद्देश्य के लिए किया जाता है?
options: It returns the total byte size of each array dimension
It returns the maximum number of elements that can be stored in the array
It returns the dimension (number of dimensions) of the specified array type
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.answer_text: It returns the dimension (number of dimensions) of the specified array typeDetailed
questions.explanation: `std::rank<T>::value` in `<type_traits>` queries the compile-time type of an array and returns the number of dimensions (e.g., rank of `int[5]` is 1, rank of `int[3][4]` is 2).💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Rank of an array = Dimension count (1D -> 1, 2D -> 2, 3D -> 3).

questions.en: What is the scope of a local variable declared inside a user-defined function block?(
questions.hi: उपयोगकर्ता द्वारा परिभाषित फ़ंक्शन ब्लॉक में घोषित स्थानीय चर (variable) का स्कोप क्या होता है?)
options: Whole program
Only inside the enclosing `{}` block
Inside the main function
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Block scope (local scope) dictates that variables declared inside a set of braces `{}` are created when execution enters the block and destroyed upon exiting, being invisible outside it.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Local variable scope = Only within the enclosing `{}` curly braces; Global variables = File/program scope.

questions.en: Which of the following statements is true about 'new' and 'malloc' in C++?I. The 'new' is an operator while 'malloc' is a library function.II. The 'new' invokes constructors, whereas 'malloc' does not invoke constructors.III. The 'malloc' returns a void pointer needing typecasting, whereas 'new' returns the typed pointer.(
questions.hi: न्यू (new) और मैलॉक (malloc) के बारे में कौन-सा/से कथन सत्य है/हैं?)
options: Only I
Both I and II
Both II and III
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.answer_text: More than one of the aboveDetailed
questions.explanation: All three statements I, II, and III are valid distinctions: `new` is a type-safe operator that calls constructors and returns `T*`, whereas `malloc` is an untyped C function that returns `void*` and does not call constructors.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Because statements I, II, and III are all factually correct, Option (D) ('More than one of the above') is triggered.

questions.en: Which class members are inherited by derived classes in C++ but remain inaccessible directly within the derived class body?
questions.hi: C++ में कौन-से क्लास सदस्य व्युत्पन्न क्लास द्वारा विरासत में प्राप्त होते हैं, लेकिन सीधे उस क्लास में सुलभ नहीं होते हैं?
options: Public members
Protected members
Private members
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: `private` members of a base class are inherited as part of the total memory layout of the derived class, but they cannot be accessed directly by derived class member functions (enforcing encapsulation).💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Access inheritance rule: `public` & `protected` members are accessible in derived class; `private` members exist in object memory but are strictly inaccessible.

questions.en: Which of the following statements regarding function resolution is completely true?I. In an object-oriented programming language, all function calls are resolved at compile-time.II. In a procedural programming language, all function calls are resolved at compile-time.
questions.hi: फ़ंक्शन रिज़ॉल्यूशन के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन पूर्णतः सत्य है?
options: Only II
Only I
Both I and II
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: In procedural languages (C), all calls are statically bound at compile-time. In OOP languages, virtual function calls are dynamically bound at runtime (late binding), making Statement I false and Statement II true.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: OOP uses dynamic/late runtime binding for virtual functions, so not all calls are resolved at compile time.

questions.en: What will happen if in a C++ program, an unnamed (anonymous) class is declared?(
questions.hi: यदि C++ प्रोग्राम में किसी अनाम (Anonymous) क्लास को घोषित किया जाए, तो क्या होगा?)
options: It is not allowed in C++ under any circumstances
It will not have a constructor
It will not have a destructor
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.answer_text: More than one of the aboveDetailed
questions.explanation: An anonymous class has no identifier name. Because constructors and destructors must share the name of their class (`ClassName()` and `~ClassName()`), an unnamed class can have neither a constructor nor a destructor.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Because an anonymous class has no name, it can have NEITHER a constructor NOR a destructor. Both (B) and (C) are true -> Select (D)!

questions.en: How can compile-time (static) polymorphism be implemented in the C++ programming language?(C++
questions.hi: प्रोग्रामिंग भाषा में संकलन-समय (compile-time) बहुरूपता को कैसे कार्यान्वित किया जा सकता है?)
options: By using function and operator overloading
By using template metaprogramming
By using virtual functions and dynamic dispatch
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.answer_text: More than one of the aboveDetailed
questions.explanation: Compile-time polymorphism is achieved through function overloading, operator overloading, and templates. Virtual functions implement runtime (dynamic) polymorphism.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Compile-time polymorphism = Overloading & Templates (Both A and B -> Option D); Runtime polymorphism = Virtual functions.

questions.en: Which of the following terms refers to the wrapping up of data and functions into a single cohesive unit?
questions.hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा डेटा और उससे संबंधित फ़ंक्शंस को एक एकल इकाई में लपेटने को संदर्भित करता है?
options: Modularity
Abstraction
Encapsulation
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Encapsulation is the mechanism that binds data together with the functions that manipulate that data, shielding them from unauthorized external interference and misuse.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Wrapping data + code = Encapsulation; Hiding background implementation details = Abstraction; Reusability = Inheritance.

questions.en: Among the following, which statement accurately defines 'modularity' in software engineering?
questions.hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सॉफ्टवेयर इंजीनियरिंग में 'मॉड्यूलैरिटी' को सही ढंग से परिभाषित करता है?
options: Modularity means hiding internal parts of the program from users
Modularity refers to dividing a program into smaller, manageable and independent sub-units
It refers to overloading the program's functions
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.answer_text: Modularity refers to dividing a program into smaller, manageable and independent sub-unitsDetailed
questions.explanation: Modularity is a software design technique that decomposes a complex system into smaller, self-contained, and interchangeable modules with well-defined interfaces.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Decomposition into independent modules = Modularity; Data hiding = Encapsulation/Abstraction.

questions.en: Which one of the following is NOT an application of the stack data structure?(
questions.hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा स्टैक (Stack) डेटा संरचना का अनुप्रयोग नहीं है?)
options: Asynchronous data transfer between processes
String reversal
Backtracking in maze and search algorithms
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Asynchronous data transfer buffers (like print spoolers and I/O pipe buffers) operate on a First-In, First-Out (FIFO) basis using Queues. Stacks are used for string reversal, backtracking, and expression evaluation.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Asynchronous transfer / Buffering = Queue; Undo operations / Backtracking / Recursion = Stack.

questions.en: Which of the following is the correct prefix notation for the infix expression `A + B * C`?(
questions.hi: इनफिक्स अभिव्यक्ति `A + B * C` का सही प्रीफिक्स (Prefix) रूप कौन-सा है?)
options: `+ A * B C`
`A B C + *`
`+ A B * C`
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Multiplication `*` has higher operator precedence than addition `+`. Thus `(B * C)` becomes `* B C`. Adding `A`: `+ A (* B C)` yields `+ A * B C`.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Precedence parsing: `B * C` -> `* B C`; then `A + (* B C)` -> `+ A * B C`.

questions.en: Which data structure is fundamentally required to convert infix expressions to prefix notation?
questions.hi: इनफिक्स को प्रीफिक्स नोटेशन में बदलने के लिए किस डेटा संरचना की आवश्यकता होती है?
options: Queue
Stack
Linked list
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Conversion algorithms (including reversal-based Shunting-yard algorithms) utilize an operator Stack to preserve and reverse operator priorities during notation transformation.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: All expression conversions (Infix to Postfix, Infix to Prefix) and evaluations require a **Stack**.

questions.en: Which computer architecture and memory hierarchy property relies heavily on the contiguous layout of arrays?(
questions.hi: ऐरे के सन्निहित (contiguous) मेमोरी लेआउट पर कौन-सा कंप्यूटर आर्किटेक्चर गुण अत्यधिक निर्भर करता है?)
options: Binary search tree indexing
Scheduling of processes
Spatial locality of reference
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Arrays store elements in contiguous physical memory addresses. When one element is fetched into CPU cache, adjacent array elements are loaded into the same cache line, maximizing spatial locality.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Contiguous sequential memory = **Spatial Locality**; Re-accessing recently used memory = **Temporal Locality**.

questions.en: The necessary condition that must be verified before performing a deletion operation from a queue is(
questions.hi: क्यू (Queue) से किसी तत्त्व को हटाने (dequeue) से पहले किस आवश्यक स्थिति की जाँच की जानी चाहिए?)
options: Front value
Underflow condition
Overflow condition
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Attempting to delete an element from an empty data structure results in Underflow. Attempting to insert into a full structure results in Overflow.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Deletion pre-check = **Underflow** (is it empty?); Insertion pre-check = **Overflow** (is it full?).

questions.en: Which one of the following is NOT an application of the queue data structure?(
questions.hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा क्यू (Queue) डेटा संरचना का अनुप्रयोग नहीं है?)
options: Data transferred asynchronously between two processes
Shared resource scheduling (e.g., CPU, disk, print spooler)
Balancing of parentheses and syntactic symbols
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.answer_text: Balancing of parentheses and syntactic symbolsDetailed
questions.explanation: Parentheses checking and nested symbol balancing strictly require a Last-In, First-Out (LIFO) Stack. Queues are FIFO structures used in asynchronous I/O and job scheduling.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Balancing parentheses = Stack; Print spooling and CPU scheduling = Queue.

questions.en: Which of the following is a standard depth-first traversal technique applied to binary trees?
questions.hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी बाइनरी ट्री में मानक डेप्थ-फर्स्ट ट्रैवर्सल तकनीक है?
options: Preorder traversal
Inorder traversal
Postorder traversal
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.answer_text: More than one of the aboveDetailed
questions.explanation: The three classic depth-first search (DFS) traversals for binary trees are Preorder (Node-Left-Right), Inorder (Left-Node-Right), and Postorder (Left-Right-Node).💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: All three (A), (B), and (C) are valid binary tree traversals, so select **(D) More than one of the above**.

questions.en: How can an array data structure be described in the best possible way?(
questions.hi: हम किसी ऐरे (Array) का सर्वोत्तम संभव तरीके से वर्णन कैसे कर सकते हैं?)
options: Arrays are dynamic and immutable structures
Container that stores elements of similar data types in contiguous memory locations
The array is an associative non-linear data structure
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.answer_text: Container that stores elements of similar data types in contiguous memory locationsDetailed
questions.explanation: An array is defined as a fixed-size, linear, contiguous collection of homogeneous elements of the same data type accessible via numerical indices.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Canonical array definition = Homogeneous elements (same type) stored in contiguous memory locations.

questions.en: What is another widely used name for a circular queue?(
questions.hi: सर्कुलर क्यू (Circular Queue) का दूसरा प्रचलित नाम क्या है?)
options: Rectangle buffer
Square buffer
Ring buffer
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: In computer engineering and systems programming, a circular queue connects its last position back to the first position in a logical circle, and is universally referred to as a Ring Buffer or Circular Buffer.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Circular Queue = **Ring Buffer** (frequently used in hardware DMA and audio/video streaming).

questions.en: Which operational limitation of linear queues determines the primary need for a circular queue?
questions.hi: रैखिक क्यू की कौन-सी परिचालन सीमा सर्कुलर क्यू की प्राथमिक आवश्यकता को निर्धारित करती है?
options: To access the queue using priority levels
To avoid memory wastage caused by unused front slots after deletions
To bypass the FIFO principle
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.answer_text: To avoid memory wastage caused by unused front slots after deletionsDetailed
questions.explanation: In a standard linear array queue, dequeuing elements leaves empty spaces at the front that cannot be reused once `rear` hits the maximum bound. Circular queues wrap around to reuse these freed positions.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Primary motivation for Circular Queue = Reclaiming unused memory space at the front of the array.

questions.en: Which data structure provides the most efficient implementation for a priority queue?(
questions.hi: प्राथमिकता क्यू (Priority Queue) को लागू करने के लिए कौन-सी डेटा संरचना सबसे कुशल है?)
options: Singly linked list
Unsorted array
Binary heap
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: A Binary Heap (min-heap or max-heap) implements Priority Queues with optimal \(O(\log N)\) insertion and \(O(\log N)\) extraction of the minimum/maximum element, outperforming \(O(N)\) arrays and linked lists.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Standard data structure for Priority Queue = **Binary Heap** (\(O(\log N)\) operations).

questions.en: Which of the following data structures is implicitly utilized by computer hardware and compilers to execute recursive functions?(
questions.hi: रिकर्शन (Recursion) को निष्पादित करने के लिए कंपाइलर और हार्डवेयर द्वारा किस डेटा संरचना का अंतर्निहित उपयोग किया जाता है?)
options: Stack (Call Stack)
Linked list
Array
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Each recursive invocation pushes an activation record (stack frame) containing return addresses, parameters, and local variables onto the system Call Stack, which unwinds in LIFO order upon return.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Function calls and recursion = System **Call Stack**.

questions.en: Which of the following represents an essential structural property of a Red-Black Tree?(
questions.hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा लाल-काले ट्री (Red-Black Tree) का एक अनिवार्य संरचनात्मक गुण है?)
options: The root node is always Black
Every newly inserted node is initially Red
If a node is Red, both of its children must be Black (no two consecutive Red nodes)
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.answer_text: More than one of the aboveDetailed
questions.explanation: Standard Red-Black tree invariants state: (1) The root is black, (2) Newly inserted nodes are colored red, and (3) Red nodes cannot have red children (no consecutive reds).💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: All three options (A), (B), and (C) are fundamental rules of Red-Black Trees, leading directly to Option (D).

questions.en: In a Double-Ended Queue (Deque) implemented using a singly linked list without backward pointers, what is the worst-case time complexity to delete an element from the rear end?(
questions.hi: एकल लिंक्ड सूची द्वारा कार्यान्वित डेक (Deque) में, पीछे के छोर (rear end) से किसी तत्त्व को हटाने की समय जटिलता क्या होगी?)
options: O(N log N)
O(N)
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: In a singly linked list, although we maintain a `tail` pointer, deleting the tail requires updating the second-to-last node's `next` pointer to `NULL`. Finding this preceding node requires traversing \(N-1\) links, taking \(O(N)\) time.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Singly linked list: Delete from Front = \(O(1)\); Delete from Rear = \(O(N)\) (needs traversal). Doubly linked list achieves \(O(1)\).

questions.en: Which of the following constitutes the exact overflow condition if a linear queue is implemented using an array of size `MAX_SIZE`?(
questions.hi: यदि `MAX_SIZE` आकार वाले ऐरे का उपयोग करके रैखिक क्यू लागू की जाती है, तो अतिप्रवाह (Overflow) की सही स्थिति कौन-सी है?)
options: `rear == MAX_SIZE - 1`
`rear == MAX_SIZE`
`rear == front + 1`
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: With zero-based indexing in an array of size `MAX_SIZE`, valid indices span `0` to `MAX_SIZE - 1`. When `rear` reaches index `MAX_SIZE - 1`, the queue cannot accommodate any further elements.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Array boundary: max index = `size - 1`. Therefore overflow occurs when `rear == MAX_SIZE - 1`.

questions.en: Which of the following sorting algorithms is strictly based on the 'Divide-and-Conquer' algorithmic paradigm?(
questions.hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा सॉर्टिंग एल्गोरिदम 'फूट डालो और जीतो' (Divide-and-Conquer) रणनीति पर आधारित है?)
options: Merge sort
Heap sort
Bubble sort
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Merge Sort divides the unsorted list into \(N\) sublists until each contains 1 element, recursively sorts them, and merges them back together. Quick Sort and Merge Sort are classic Divide-and-Conquer algorithms.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Divide and Conquer sorting = Merge Sort & Quick Sort; Greedy sorting = Selection Sort; Heap-based = Heap Sort.

questions.en: What is a Database?(
questions.hi: डेटाबेस (Database) क्या है?)
options: An unorganized repository of files that cannot be queried or updated
An organized collection of interrelated data or information that can be easily accessed, managed, and updated
A hardware storage unit that only stores operating system files
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.answer_text: An organized collection of interrelated data or information that can be easily accessed, managed, and updatedDetailed
questions.explanation: A database is a systematic, logically structured collection of persistent, interrelated data stored electronically in a computer system designed for efficient querying, updating, and administration.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Standard definition: Organized collection of interrelated data managed by a DBMS.

questions.en: Which diverse types of data can be effectively stored in modern database management systems?
questions.hi: आधुनिक डेटाबेस प्रबंधन प्रणालियों में किस प्रकार का डेटा संग्रहीत किया जा सकता है?
options: Image-oriented binary data (BLOBs)
Structured textual and numerical data
Multimedia data in the form of audio and video streams
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.answer_text: More than one of the aboveDetailed
questions.explanation: Modern enterprise relational and object-relational databases accommodate alphanumeric data, unstructured text, binary images, audio, video files (via BLOBs and CLOBs), and spatial coordinates.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Modern databases handle text, numbers, images, audio, and video. Since all three are supported, Option (D) is the answer.

questions.en: Which of the following is NOT a recognized traditional architectural model of databases?
questions.hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा पारंपरिक डेटाबेस संरचना का एक मान्यता प्राप्त प्रकार नहीं है?
options: Network Database Model
Distributed Database Model
Decentralized Database Model
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Classical database architectures include Hierarchical, Network, Relational, Object-Oriented, and Distributed. 'Decentralized' is a distributed ledger/blockchain concept, not a traditional DBMS architectural category.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Standard DBMS models: Relational, Hierarchical, Network, Distributed. 'Decentralized' is not a formal DBMS architecture.

questions.en: Which of the following software applications is NOT an example of a Database Management System (DBMS)?
questions.hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा DBMS का उदाहरण नहीं है?
options: Microsoft Access
IBM Db2
Google Search Engine
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Microsoft Access and IBM Db2 are specialized Database Management Systems. Google is an internet search engine, web crawler, and technology corporation, not a standalone DBMS product.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: DBMS products: Oracle, MySQL, SQL Server, MS Access, IBM Db2, PostgreSQL. Google is a search engine.

questions.en: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic feature of an enterprise Relational Database Management System?
questions.hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी रिलेशनल DBMS की विशेषता नहीं है?
options: Minimum duplication and redundancy of data
Strict single-user access only
Support for ACID transaction properties
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Enterprise DBMS platforms are built specifically to support concurrent, multi-user transactions while maintaining isolation. Single-user access only is an archaic limitation, not a feature.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: DBMS provides multi-user concurrency control. Single-user access only is false.

questions.en: Which of the following is NOT an internal core function of a database system?
questions.hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा डेटाबेस का आंतरिक कार्य नहीं है?
options: Manipulating and querying stored data
Ensuring security and access privileges for data
Analysing and compiling compiler source code
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.answer_text: Analysing and compiling compiler source codeDetailed
questions.explanation: A DBMS provides query manipulation, transaction management, indexing, concurrency control, and security access. Compiling and analyzing source code is performed by language compilers and IDEs.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Compiling and syntax analysis is the job of a Compiler, not a Database system.

questions.en: Information about data, such as schema definition, column constraints, and storage specifications, is termed as(
questions.hi: डेटा के बारे में डेटा या जानकारी (Information about data) क्या कहलाती है?)
options: Teradata
Metadata
Relational tuples
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Metadata is defined as 'data about data', comprising data dictionary descriptions, table schemas, column data types, indexing definitions, and access privileges.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Data about data = **Metadata**; stored in the System Catalog / Data Dictionary.

questions.en: In a multi-tier enterprise architecture, a Database Management System acts as an interface between
questions.hi: DBMS एक एंटरप्राइज़-क्लास सिस्टम में किनके बीच एक इंटरफ़ेस के रूप में कार्य करता है?
options: Raw hardware data and the operating system
Database application program and the physical database
The end-user monitor and peripheral firmware
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.answer_text: Database application program and the physical databaseDetailed
questions.explanation: The DBMS serves as the software middleware that translates high-level user/application SQL queries into low-level physical file system reads and writes against the physical database storage.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: DBMS sits between the Application Program / User and the Physical Storage Files.

questions.en: A set of one or more attributes that, taken collectively, allows us to uniquely identify a record/tuple in a relation is called a
questions.hi: किसी रिकॉर्ड को विशिष्ट रूप से पहचानने के लिए सामूहिक रूप से ली गई एक या अधिक विशेषताओं का सेट क्या कहलाता है?
options: Primary key
Foreign key
Superkey
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: By relational database theory definition, a Superkey is any superset of attributes that uniquely identifies a tuple. A minimal superkey is designated as a Candidate Key, one of which is chosen as the Primary Key.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Collective attributes that uniquely identify a row = **Superkey**; Minimal superkey = Candidate key; Chosen candidate key = Primary key.

questions.en: Which of the following SQL DML commands is correct to delete all row values from the relation 'teaches' while keeping the table structure intact?(
questions.hi: संबंध 'teaches' के टेबल स्ट्रक्चर को बनाए रखते हुए उसके सभी मानों (रो) को हटाने के लिए सही SQL कमांड कौन-सा है?)
options: `DELETE FROM teaches;`
`DELETE FROM teaches WHERE Id='Null';`
`REMOVE TABLE teaches;`
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: The SQL syntax `DELETE FROM table_name;` purges all rows from the table while retaining its schema and column definitions in the data dictionary. `DROP TABLE` deletes both rows and schema.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Delete data only = `DELETE FROM table_name;`; Delete entire table and schema = `DROP TABLE table_name;`.

questions.en: In the ANSI/ISO SQL environment hierarchy, the top level consists of _____ each of which can contain multiple _____.
questions.hi: ANSI/ISO SQL पदानुक्रम के शीर्ष स्तर में _____ होते हैं, जिनमें से प्रत्येक में कई _____ हो सकते हैं।
options: schemas, catalogs
schemas, environments
catalogs, schemas
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: In standard SQL database architecture, an Environment contains Catalogs (databases), and each Catalog contains one or more Schemas (user namespaces), which in turn contain tables, views, and constraints.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: SQL hierarchy order: Environment -> Catalogs -> Schemas -> Tables/Views.

questions.en: In Microsoft SQL Server security administration, user database logins and IDs can be added or removed using which fixed database role?(
questions.hi: डेटाबेस सुरक्षा प्रशासन में उपयोगकर्ता आईडी को जोड़ने या हटाने के लिए किस निश्चित भूमिका (fixed role) का उपयोग किया जाता है?)
options: `db_sysadmin`
`db_accessadmin`
`db_securityadmin`
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: In SQL Server, members of the `db_accessadmin` fixed database role have permissions to add or remove access to the database for Windows logins, Windows groups, and SQL Server logins.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Add/remove user access rights = `db_accessadmin`; Manage permissions and roles = `db_securityadmin`.

questions.en: The traditional storage of business records organized by customer name, stored in physical folders within filing cabinets, directly mirrors which database model?
questions.hi: फाइलिंग कैबिनेट में फ़ोल्डरों में संग्रहीत डेटा का पारंपरिक भंडारण किस डेटाबेस मॉडल का प्रत्यक्ष उदाहरण है?
options: Relational database management system
Network database management system
Hierarchical database management system
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: In a physical filing cabinet, files are organized into a strict top-down tree hierarchy (Cabinet -> Drawer -> Folder -> Document), directly representing a 1:N parent-child Hierarchical Database Model.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Parent-child 1:N tree hierarchy = **Hierarchical Model**; Many-to-many graph = **Network Model**; Tables/relations = **Relational Model**.

questions.en: After groups have been established via `GROUP BY`, SQL applies filtering conditions on aggregate functions using which clause?(
questions.hi: ग्रुप स्थापित होने के बाद, SQL समग्र (Aggregate) कार्यों पर शर्तें लागू करने के लिए किस खंड (clause) का उपयोग करता है?)
options: `HAVING` clause
`GROUP BY` clause
`WHERE` clause
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: In SQL, individual rows are filtered before grouping using the `WHERE` clause. Once groups are formed via `GROUP BY`, aggregate conditions (`COUNT() > 5`, `AVG() > 50`) can only be filtered using the `HAVING` clause.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Filter individual rows = `WHERE`; Filter groups / aggregate functions = `HAVING`.

questions.en: Which of the following operations is NOT considered an internal utility service of a DBMS?I. Backup and recoveryII. Data loadingIII. Operating system process schedulingIV. File reorganization(
questions.hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी DBMS की उपयोगिताएँ (Utilities) नहीं हैं?)
options: I, II and IV only
I, II and III only
III only (Operating system process scheduling)
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: DBMS utility programs provide backup, recovery, data loading, and index reorganization. Process scheduling across CPU cores is strictly an Operating System kernel responsibility.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Process scheduling belongs to the OS kernel, not the database engine.

questions.en: For designing a practical, well-normalized enterprise Relational Database, which Normal Form is generally considered sufficient and adequate?(
questions.hi: सामान्य RDBMS को डिज़ाइन करने के लिए निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा सामान्य रूप (Normal Form) पर्याप्त माना जाता है?)
options: 4NF
3NF (Third Normal Form)
2NF
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: In commercial database design, Third Normal Form (3NF) or BCNF is considered the standard target. It eliminates all partial and transitive functional dependencies while preserving dependencies without performance penalties.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Industry standard target for RDBMS normalization = **3NF**.

questions.en: What severe anomalies occur if identical business data is redundantly stored in two separate tables in a database?
questions.hi: यदि डेटा का एक ही टुकड़ा डेटाबेस में दो अलग-अलग स्थानों पर संग्रहीत किया जाता है, तो क्या परिणाम होता है?
options: Valuable storage space is wasted
Updating data in one spot will cause data inconsistency across the database
Modification anomalies arise
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.answer_text: More than one of the aboveDetailed
questions.explanation: Data redundancy leads to wasted disk storage, potential update/insertion/deletion anomalies, and data inconsistency when one copy is updated while the duplicate copy retains obsolete data.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Consequences of data redundancy: (A) Wasted storage, (B) Data inconsistency, (C) Update anomalies. Hence Option (D).

questions.en: In relational database systems, which data type is specifically designed to store raw, unstructured binary byte data in a table column?
questions.hi: रिलेशनल डेटाबेस में कौन-सा डेटा टाइप असंरचित बाइनरी डेटा को कॉलम में संग्रहीत करने के लिए बनाया गया है?
options: RAW / BLOB
Numeric
VARCHAR
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: The `RAW` and `BLOB` (Binary Large Object) data types are designed to store raw uninterpreted binary bytes (e.g., compiled binaries, encrypted signatures, images) without character-set translation.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Unstructured binary data = `RAW` / `BLOB`; Formatted text = `VARCHAR`; Numbers = `NUMERIC`.

questions.en: Which logic gate provides a HIGH (1) output when both of its inputs are identical (either both 0 or both 1)?(
questions.hi: लॉजिक गेट, जो समान इनपुट होने पर (दोनों 0 या दोनों 1) उच्च (HIGH/1) आउटपुट प्रदान करता है, कहलाता है)
options: NOT gate
X-NOR gate (Equivalence gate)
XOR gate
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: An X-NOR (Exclusive-NOR) gate outputs 1 when inputs are equal (`0 XNOR 0 = 1`, `1 XNOR 1 = 1`) and 0 when inputs differ. Hence it is also known as the Coincidence or Equivalence gate.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: High for SAME inputs = **X-NOR (Equivalence)**; High for DIFFERENT inputs = **XOR (Inequality)**.

questions.en: Boolean algebra is fundamentally applied in
questions.hi: बूलियन बीजगणित का उपयोग मुख्य रूप से किसमें किया जाता है?
options: Designing digital computer hardware and processors
Constructing and simplifying logic gate networks
Switching circuit theory
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.answer_text: More than one of the aboveDetailed
questions.explanation: Claude Shannon established that Boolean algebra models electrical relay circuits. It is the mathematical foundation for digital IC design, processor ALU construction, and switching network theory.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Boolean algebra applies to digital computer design, circuit theory, and logic gate symbols -> Select Option (D).

questions.en: Communication between a personal computer and a keyboard involves which transmission mode?
questions.hi: कंप्यूटर और कीबोर्ड के बीच संचार में किस प्रकार का ट्रांसमिशन शामिल होता है?
options: Simplex transmission
Half-duplex transmission
Full-duplex transmission
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: In Simplex mode, data communication occurs strictly in one unidirectional channel. A keyboard can only send keystroke data to the computer; the computer cannot transmit user input back to the keyboard.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Unidirectional (Keyboard -> PC, TV broadcast) = **Simplex**; Alternate two-way (Walkie-talkie) = **Half-Duplex**; Simultaneous two-way (Telephone) = **Full-Duplex**.

questions.en: What is the simplified form of the Boolean expression `(X + Y + XY)(X + Z)`?(
questions.hi: बूलियन अभिव्यक्ति `(X + Y + XY)(X + Z)` का सरलीकृत रूप क्या है?)
options: `XY + YZ`
`X + YZ`
`XZ + Y`
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: By absorption, `X + Y + XY = X + Y(1 + X) = X + Y`. Then `(X + Y)(X + Z)`. By distributive law of Boolean algebra, `(X + Y)(X + Z) = X + YZ`.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Distributive law identity: `(A + B)(A + C) = A + BC`. Here `(X + Y)(X + Z) = X + YZ`.

questions.en: The dual of a Boolean expression is obtained by which mathematical rule?(
questions.hi: किसी बूलियन अभिव्यक्ति का द्वैत (Dual) किसके द्वारा प्राप्त किया जाता है?)
options: Interchanging all 0s and 1s only
Interchanging all AND (`.`) with OR (`+`) operators, and interchanging all 0s with 1s without complementing variables
Complementing all literal variables without changing operator signs
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.answer_text: Interchanging all AND (`.`) with OR (`+`) operators, and interchanging all 0s with 1s without complementing variablesDetailed
questions.explanation: Duality Principle: The dual of a Boolean expression is obtained by replacing each AND (`.`) with OR (`+`), each OR with AND, each 0 with 1, and each 1 with 0, leaving variables intact.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Principle of Duality: `+` <-> `.`, and `0` <-> `1`. Do NOT complement variables!

questions.en: Wireless transmission of data signals across networks can be accomplished through
questions.hi: नेटवर्क में संकेतों का वायरलेस ट्रांसमिशन किसके माध्यम से किया जा सकता है?
options: Radio waves
Microwaves
Infrared waves
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.answer_text: More than one of the aboveDetailed
questions.explanation: Wireless unguided transmission utilizes electromagnetic frequencies spanning radio waves (Wi-Fi, cellular), microwaves (satellite links, terrestrial towers), and infrared (short-range line-of-sight).💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Radio waves, microwaves, and infrared are all standard wireless communication bands -> Option (D).

questions.en: In computer networks, what does the acronym 'DNS' stand for?
questions.hi: कम्प्यूटर नेटवर्क में 'DNS' का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
options: Data Network Service
Domain Name System
Digital Network Standard
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: The Domain Name System (DNS) is an application-layer hierarchical protocol that translates human-friendly domain names (e.g., www.bpsc.bih.nic.in) into machine-readable numeric IP addresses.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: DNS = Domain Name System (acts as the phonebook of the Internet, translating names to IP addresses).

questions.en: In synchronous Time Division Multiplexing (TDM), transmission frames are composed of individual(
questions.hi: टाइम डिवीज़न मल्टीप्लेक्सिंग (TDM) में, स्लॉट (Slots) आगे किसमें विभाजित होते हैं?)
options: Frames
Packets
Bits or bit groups
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: In TDM systems, each continuous time frame contains a set of fixed time slots assigned to channels, where each slot carries a discrete unit of data down to individual bits or characters.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: In TDM, each time frame is partitioned into time slots, which transport serialized **bits**.

questions.en: Which of the following statements is true regarding Transmission Control Protocol (TCP)?(
questions.hi: ट्रांसमिशन कंट्रोल प्रोटोकॉल (TCP) के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सत्य है?)
options: It is a connection-oriented reliable protocol operating at Transport Layer
It uses a three-way handshake (SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK) to establish a connection
It provides flow control, error recovery, and packet retransmission
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.answer_text: More than one of the aboveDetailed
questions.explanation: TCP is a connection-oriented Layer 4 protocol that guarantees reliable delivery via three-way handshakes, sequence numbers, sliding-window flow control, and checksum error checking.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: TCP is connection-oriented, reliable, and uses a 3-way handshake -> All statements are true -> Option (D).

questions.en: Which of the following application software is classified as a Web Browser?
questions.hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा अनुप्रयोग सॉफ्टवेयर 'वेब ब्राउज़र' के रूप में वर्गीकृत है?
options: Google Chrome
Mozilla Firefox
Apple Safari
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.answer_text: More than one of the aboveDetailed
questions.explanation: Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, and Apple Safari are standard client web browser applications used to fetch, render, and navigate HTML web pages across the World Wide Web.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, Opera are all web browsers -> Select Option (D).

questions.en: Which transmission media provides the highest bandwidth and data transmission speed in modern communication networks?
questions.hi: कौन-सा ट्रांसमिशन मीडिया किसी नेटवर्क में उच्चतम ट्रांसमिशन गति और बैंडविड्थ प्रदान करता है?
options: Coaxial cable
Shielded Twisted-pair cable (STP)
Optical fiber cable
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Fiber-optic cables transmit digital pulses of light through high-purity glass cores via total internal reflection, providing terabit-per-second bandwidth with negligible attenuation and zero EMI.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Speed & Bandwidth hierarchy: **Optical Fiber >> Coaxial Cable > Twisted Pair (Cat6/Cat5e)**.

questions.en: In SQL, which command is used to permanently remove an entire table structure along with all of its stored records from the database?
questions.hi: SQL में, डेटाबेस से किसी संपूर्ण टेबल स्ट्रक्चर और उसके सभी रिकॉर्ड को स्थायी रूप से हटाने के लिए किस कमांड का उपयोग किया जाता है?
options: DELETE
DROP TABLE
ERASE
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation:
`DROP TABLE table_name;` is a Data Definition Language (DDL) command that drops the table schema, indexes, and all rows permanently. `DELETE` is DML and removes only rows.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Delete data rows only = `DELETE`; Remove data + schema permanently = `DROP TABLE`.

BPSC TRE 4.0: Computer Science 5-Option Elimination StrategyTactical Guidelines for Tackling Option (D) 'More than one of the above' and Option (E) 'None of the above' in Technical MCQs
1. The 2-Check Rule for Option (D) in Technical Questions:Whenever you independently confirm that two choices satisfy the technical criteria (e.g., both Encapsulation and Polymorphism in pure OOP; both Default and Copy constructor; both Compiler and Assembler as translators; both Radio waves and Microwaves in wireless transmission), stop analyzing choice (C) and mark (D) ('More than one of the above') immediately.2. The Missing Key Entity Trap for Option (E):BPSC question setters frequently construct questions testing famous computer algorithms, hardware pioneers, or units (e.g., Dijkstra's algorithm for shortest paths, Turing machine, or non-listed memory units) and deliberately omit the correct answer from (A), (B), and (C). Candidates who second-guess themselves often pick a plausible-looking distractor instead of selecting (E) ('None of the above').3. Hardware vs. Software vs. Operating System Traps:Watch out for classification traps where system software utilities (e.g., compilers, defragmenters) are mixed with OS kernel responsibilities (e.g., CPU process scheduling), or database engines (Oracle, Db2) with internet search engines (Google). Operating system process scheduling and memory management belong to the OS kernel, not the DBMS.4. Default Access Specifier Distinctions:One of BPSC's most tested distinctions is structure vs. class default access. Remember: `struct` members and inheritance are PUBLIC by default (C compatibility); `class` members and inheritance are PRIVATE by default (encapsulation).
